verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows GrowthBook is self-hostable and that targeting-attribute values are never sent to the vendor, but there is no documentation of any product telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting or flag for the self-hosted or cloud application itself. Missing for 10: any explicit telemetry/usage-analytics toggle, docs on what data is phoned home from self-hosted instances, or a documented opt-out mechanism.
